variants.prompt: In a dimly lit, upscale cocktail lounge, Ruby reclines seductively on a plush leather couch, her lacy black bra and matching thong visible beneath a sheer, sequined robe that hangs open to reveal her toned midriff. Her raven hair cascades down her back in loose waves as she tilts her head, gazing at the viewer with a sultry, half-lidded stare. The warm glow of candles and the minimalist background accentuate her alluring figure, while the cinematic shallow depth of field draws focus to her sensual, inviting expression.
